programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: A rich old man and a sexy young photographer compete for a stunning young gym instructor. The younger man is clearly winning until the rich man offers a deal.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming is a mole in the police department and Yan is a police mole in the Triads. Leading parallel lives, Ming and Yan are feeling increasingly trapped in their false surroundings and they're desperate to find a way out.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: A Chinese warlord hires a conjurer to help him impress a resistant concubine.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: Seorang makelar properti ditarik kembali ke kehidupan yang ditinggalkannya setelah mantan rekannya dalam kejahatan muncul kembali dengan pesan yang tidak menyenangkan.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: The last day of school turns into a nightmare for two high school teachers as they settle their differences the hard way.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: Setahun setelah pembuangan mayat seorang pria yang tidak sengaja mereka bunuh, sekelompok remaja bodoh dibuntuti oleh seorang pembunuh berantai yang kikuk.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: Setahun setelah pembuangan mayat seorang pria yang tidak sengaja mereka bunuh, sekelompok remaja bodoh dibuntuti oleh seorang pembunuh berantai yang kikuk.

programme.title: Dirty Angels
programme.desc: Setelah penarikan pasukan AS dari Afghanistan pada tahun 2021, sekelompok tentara wanita dikirim kembali untuk menyelamatkan sekelompok remaja yang diculik.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: Seorang mantan anggota pasukan khusus AS yang membangkang membantu teroris melakukan aksi-aksi melawan Barat; namun, tidak jelas di mana letak loyalitas pria tersebut.
Pada musim panas tahun 1961, dua pemain baseball dan sahabat bersaing untuk memecahkan rekor home run yang dibuat oleh Babe Ruth yang legendaris pada tahun 1927.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Brad Whitaker adalah pembawa acara radio yang berusaha membuat anak tirinya mencintainya dan memanggilnya Ayah. Namun rencananya menjadi terbalik ketika ayah kandung mereka, Dusty Mayron, kembali.

programme.title: The Good Liar
programme.desc: Seorang penipu ulung mengincar korban terbarunya – seorang wanita yang baru saja menjanda, dengan kekayaan jutaan dolar. Namun, saat keduanya semakin dekat, apa yang seharusnya menjadi penipuan sederhana berubah menjadi pertaruhan yang sangat besar.

programme.title: Get Out

programme.title: Collateral Damage
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger membalas dendam kepada teroris yang membunuh keluarganya.

programme.title: El Diablo
programme.desc: Seorang guru sekolah yang santun bersumpah untuk menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang diculik dari penjahat mematikan El Diablo.

programme.title: Clear History
programme.desc: Setelah bertengkar dengan bosnya, Nathan mengubah identitasnya untuk menghindari penghinaan publik – tetapi kemudian mendapati masa lalunya mengganggu kehidupan barunya.

programme.title: Abrakadabra
programme.desc: Abrakadabra Merupakan Sebuah Reality Show Yang Menghadirkan Hiburan Street Magician, Dimana Para "Pesulap" Akan Memberikan Keajaiban Dengan Trik-Trik Rahasia Yang Memukau Setiap Mata Di Sekitar Area Publik Untuk Mendapatkan Reaksi Kagum, Tak Percaya Dan Kaget Dari Penonton Maupun Semua Orang Yang Melihatnya Secara Langsung Di Lokasi.

programme.title: Kokom (Kompilasi Komedi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Berisikan Kompilasi Video-Video Lucu Yang Viral Di Sosial Media.

programme.title: Cahaya Bagi Negeri
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Membahas Berbagai Isu Hangat Yang Sedang Ramai Diperbincangkan Masyarakat, Dikupas Dari Sudut Pandang Spiritual Dan Nilai-Nilai Kerohanian.

programme.title: Movinesia
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Menghadirkan Sederet Film Pilihan Untuk Menemani Aktivitas Anda Dengan Dimeriahkan Oleh Para Pemain & Artis Papan Atas Berbakat, Dengan Cerita Ringan Seputar Kehidupan Remaja.

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. Pembahasan Dilakukan Sepanjang Perjalanan Menuju Lokasi Sesuai Agenda Harian Ustadz. Program Ini Akan Disajikan Secara Ringan Dan Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Lil Wild
programme.desc: Sekumpulan Sahabat Yaitu Rara Si Gajah Yang Penuh Aksi, Wobi Buaya Jenius, Meep Harimau Putih Pemalu, Kokeko Si Berang-Berang Yang Banyak Akal, Dan Dil Seekor Merpati Yang Pemberani. Mereka Tinggal Di Suatu Kebun Binatang Yang Sudah Mereka Anggap Seperti Rumah Mereka Sendiri. Mereka Berpetualang Dan Bergembira Bersama Untuk Menyelamatkan Kebun Binatang.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
